problems.problem: The formula for effective efficiency of a series system is incorrect. The nominal line efficiency is not the product of individual efficiencies; it is typically the bottleneck rate. The correct effective efficiency is the nominal line efficiency multiplied by the product of individual up-time fracti
problems.correction: the effective efficiency is approx. e_line × ∏(1/(1+λᵢrᵢ))
problems.verifierReason: Original formula misstates series line efficiency; product of e_i is not nominal rate. Correction uses bottleneck rate × product of availabilities, standard for no-buffer lines.
